title: Mash pH Outlier by Recipe
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:mash
| stats avg(ph) as avg_ph, min(ph) as min_ph, max(ph) as max_ph by recipe
| where avg_ph<5.2 OR avg_ph>5.6 OR min_ph<5.0 OR max_ph>5.8
| sort avg_ph
description: Uses Mash-process probes telemetry to monitor whether mash pH is landing inside the preferred window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for recipes that keep missing their target chemistry, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Mash-process probes data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Recipe table of average, min, and max mash pH.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors whether mash pH is landing inside the preferred window so you can spot recipes that keep missing their target chemistry before it becomes annoying.
